# Ollabs

> Free profile-picture frame campaigns. An organizer publishes one link. A supporter opens it, adds a photo, and saves a square PNG. No app, no account, and no watermark on the photo.

Ollabs is for causes, teams, churches, schools, and events. The supporter page is the product. Ads are labelled and stay off the photo and off campaign pages.

## Guides

- [How to add a frame to a profile picture](https://ollabs.studio/guides/add-a-frame-to-a-profile-picture): Four steps for someone who received a campaign link. English.
- [Como colocar uma moldura na foto de perfil](https://ollabs.studio/pt/guides/add-a-frame-to-a-profile-picture): The same steps in Portuguese.
- [How to start a campaign](https://ollabs.studio/guides/start-a-campaign): For the organizer. Upload a frame, name it, publish, share in the first hour.

## Comparisons

- [Ollabs vs Twibbonize](https://ollabs.studio/vs/twibbonize): Who pays. Twibbonize can watermark the download. Ollabs does not charge supporters.
- [Ollabs vs Twibbonize em português](https://ollabs.studio/pt/vs/twibbonize): The same comparison in Portuguese.
